# Swyft

> Swyft is a housing + moving super-app for Nairobi, Kenya. "Find a Home. Move In. All in One App." It turns house hunting into a short-form video feed and connects you to trusted movers — all in one app.

## How housing works (the core hook)
- **Discover:** A "For You" video feed of short property tours, filmed by verified Scouts. Personalised to your interests (House Hunting, Furniture, Appliances, Building & Construction).
- **Save:** Add the homes you like to your Bucket List.
- **Unlock:** Pay a small viewing fee (6% of the monthly rent) to unlock verified details — building name, directions, caretaker's phone, deposit and availability.
- **View:** Go and view the property yourself. Scouts and customers never meet — trust comes from KYC verification, ratings, and listing-freshness checks. No agents, no scams, no wasted trips.
- Browsing and saving in the feed is free.

## Moving (the Move tab)
- **Transport:** Book a single vehicle — Van, Mini Truck, Pickup, Car Rescue (towing), 5T Lorry, 10T Lorry, or boda.
- **Moving packages by home size:** Studio → 5+ bedroom, each bundled with the right truck and loaders.
- Upfront pricing, live driver tracking, M-Pesa or cash, and scheduled moves.

## Become a Scout (the content engine)
KYC-verified locals film up to 90-second property tours, earn for every approved upload, and keep 90% of every viewing fee on properties they filmed, withdrawn to M-Pesa. Apply inside the app.

## Drive with Swyft
Verified drivers go online, accept nearby orders, navigate, and get paid — managing earnings and an 18% platform commission via M-Pesa in-app.

## Swyft for Business (business.swyft.africa)
A web dashboard for companies: book verified trucks with live GPS tracking, manage every delivery in one place, and receive monthly KRA TIMS-compliant invoices — from around KES 4,500 per trip, with no fixed fleet costs. Runs on the same driver network as the app.

## Swyft Agent (agent.swyft.africa)
The web app for Kenyan landlords and property managers: "List once. Fill faster. Get paid cleaner." List a vacant unit to verified, move-ready renters (verified creators film it — no recycled photos), and run rent collection on the M-Pesa paybill or bank account you already use (M-Pesa, Equity, Co-op, KCB). Payments are auto-matched by phone number, with receipts, invoices, arrears tracking and tenant statements generated automatically. Money never moves through Swyft — it reads bank notifications, so owners keep their paybill and how tenants pay.

## Key facts
- Market: Nairobi, Kenya (and metro)
- Platforms: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play); free to download
- Payments: M-Pesa and cash (KES)
- Company: Taleel Holdings LTD.
- Support: support@swyft.africa · 0796 652 112
- Languages: English, Swahili
